title: Chargers Rookie Makes Explosive Play Before Exiting With Trainers at Minicamp
text:
One Chargers rookie looks the part, but also had to leave the field.
have a bit of a wildcard on their hands with rookies this year. Akheem Mesidor is an older rookie , so they’re hoping he can help right away after a seamless transition to the pros, compensating for the loss of Odafe Oweh.
In the second round, the Chargers took college center Jake Slaughter, hoping he can move to guard. But he’sThen there’s fourth-round pick Brenen Thompson, a speedy wideout who would seem to be a perfect fit in a Mike McDaniel offense.
Chargers rookie Brenen Thompson leaves with trainersFrom the sounds of it, Thompson is already cooking pretty well in the pros with second and third teams.captured the scene at a recent minicamp practice: “Wide receiver Brenen Thompson had an impressive contested catch during a 7-on-7 period on a pass from quarterback DJ Uiagalelei but later left practice with a trainer. ” No follow-up word on Thompson yet, but the last thing fans want to hear is that the fun rookie with 4.26 speed won’t be getting the reps necessary to adapt to the pros and climb the depth chart.
Granted, Thompson isn’t a major threat to steal playing time from the three guys in front of him on the depth chart. Ladd McConkey is the No 1 in spirit, they still clearly believe in Quentin Johnston and former second-rounder Tre Harris has No. 1 upside they want to see on the field more often. McDaniel is almost guaranteed to throw some specific packaged looks Thompson’s way, though.
The skill set is too alluring to leave on the sideline and the draft process made it very clear that he was a McDaniel pick, first and foremost. For now, the lack of more serious news from Thompson’s exit from the field means little reason to worry. And there’s some excitement there, too, that he’s already looking like a standout before training camp.
That gives him a strong shot at making a serious climb to potentially seeing first-team reps over the summer. Loading recommendations...
